name: Explorer Search History
description: Windows Explorer search bar terms (WordWheelQuery) — tracks every search you've performed
privacyImpact: Reveals search terms typed in File Explorer and Start Menu search

name: Explorer Address Bar History
description: Paths entered in the Explorer address bar, including UNC network paths
privacyImpact: Reveals manually entered paths and network locations

name: Map Network Drive MRU
description: Recently mapped network drive paths stored by Windows Explorer
privacyImpact: Reveals network shares and servers accessed via Map Network Drive

name: Taskbar Band MRU
description: History of taskbar band configuration and recently pinned items
privacyImpact: Contains taskbar layout — modifying may reset pinned items

name: Command Prompt History Size
description: Command Prompt (cmd.exe) history configuration and buffer size
privacyImpact: Console configuration — modifying may reset terminal preferences

name: PowerShell Console History
description: PowerShell console host settings and history configuration
privacyImpact: Run dialog history includes PowerShell commands

name: Application Compatibility Cache
description: Windows application compatibility telemetry and shimcache — tracks executables run on the system
privacyImpact: System-level cache of all executables run — high forensic value, red risk to modify

name: MUI Cache
description: Multilingual User Interface cache — stores display names of previously launched programs
privacyImpact: Reveals names of programs that have been executed on this machine
